description: Forecast frost and freeze nights for the next 1 to 16 days (default 16) at a ZIP code, place or coordinates: each night at or below 36 F with its category (frost possible, frost or light freeze, freeze, hard freeze), the first night at or below 32 F and the coldest night. Answers "will it frost tonight".

location.description: A US ZIP code ("80202"), a place ("Burlington, VT", "Leeds, UK") or "lat,lon". Add the state or country to a place name to avoid a same-named town.

name: frost_forecast
title: Frost forecast
